text: 龙爪控制（dsh-dragon-control）是面向 DSH Desktop 的 Windows x64 插件，注册网页和桌面操作工具。网页工具可驱动本机 Edge/Chrome，通过 DOM 读取和操作页面；桌面工具可查看窗口并使用 UI Automation 或截图交互，还支持批量动作与会话脱敏日志。适合需要让 DSH 操作网页或本地 Windows 应用的场景。需要 Windows x64 和本机浏览器；不需要 API Key。

Dragon Control is a Windows x64 DSH Desktop plugin. It registers browser and desktop tools for web interaction in Edge or Chrome and Windows app control through UI Automation or screenshots. It also supports batch actions and session history. Requires Windows x64 and a local browser; no API key.
想让 DSH 帮我在网页里查找内容并填写表单。
能不能让 DSH 操作 Windows 桌面应用和窗口控件？
I want DSH to interact with web pages and desktop apps on my Windows computer.
龙爪控制的功能「网页与桌面操作」：在 DSH 中注册网页和桌面工具，供会话读取或操作网页、查看窗口并与 Windows 控件交互；工具支持按需观察和批量动作。
dsh-dragon-control 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 21 天；提交数 7；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-dragon-control README · 龙爪控制 · dsh-dragon-control：[English](README.en.md) · 0.5.4 preview · MIT

**仅支持 Windows x64。不适用于 macOS、Linux、WSL 或无桌面的服务器。即使只用网页功能，目前也需要 Windows 后端。**

为 DSH Desktop 普通会话提供 `dragon_browser` 和 `dragon_desktop` 两个工具：通过 DOM 操作网页，通过 Windows UI Automation 操作控件，必要时使用截图和坐标。独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek、OpenAI 无隶属关系。

dsh-dragon-control README · 能做什么：- 网页：打开、读取、DOM 点击、填表、多标签、条件等待、截图及 URL 下载。
- 桌面：列出和选择窗口；按 UIA 控件句柄执行 Invoke、SetValue、Select、Toggle、Expand/Collapse；等待控件出现或消失。语义路线无需视觉模型。
- 按需截图：点击、输入、按键、拖拽、打开应用默认只续上 `observation_id`，不抓图；要画面时再用 `observe`（始终截图）。省掉每一步 2560×1440 的 PNG，实测单步（`key`）从 1.0 秒降到 0.44 秒；会话内还要再省下每帧图片的传输与落盘。
- 原生层常驻：`DragonNative.exe` / `A11yProbe.exe` 同进程复用，插件层单步（`key`，含守卫）从 1.89 秒降到 0.30 秒，真实会话单步 `key` 从约 2.94 秒降到 **约 0.68 秒**（同机 5 次，648–720 ms）；窗口身份、坐标、观察号与 Esc 急停的校验一条没减。
- 接入用户主动开启调试端口的 Chrome/Edge；连接复用该浏览器配置中的登录态，不导出或复制 Cookie。
- `batch` 一次提交最多 50 步，先校验所有步骤，依次执行、遇错即停，并逐步记录脱敏日志。已执行的步骤不会回滚。
- 精确应用路径、网站顶层来源的 read/control 授权；默认敏感动作逐次确认；用户物理 Esc 急停。

dsh-dragon-control README · 能做什么：0.5.0 把网页侧也改为自立：插件自己启动本机 Edge/Chrome（独立 `user-data-dir`）并用自带的 CDP 客户端驱动，不再需要 `dsh-builtin-browser` 或 `dsh-orb` 的 Electron。0.4.1 修复的 CDP 标签选择、跨会话隔离、标签元数据权限、写操作确认、超时取消及页面变化后的过期操作仍然有效。详见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：目前适配的组合：**Windows x64、Node.js 24、DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2、本机已安装的 Microsoft Edge 或 Google Chrome**。插件自带浏览器启动层和 CDP 客户端，不依赖其他插件；装好本插件即可单独运行。其他版本不承诺兼容。

直接在目标 DSH profile 安装本插件即可。使用默认的 `desktop` profile 时，可在兼容的 DSH CLI 中执行：

首选 npm 安装：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control。也可以从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases) 下载 tgz 和校验文件，或按版本标签安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`。需要不可变安装时，将标签换成完整源码提交 SHA。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

也可通过 DSH 插件管理安装本地 tgz。首次执行网页动作时，插件会查找 `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`，否则依次尝试系统 Edge、Chrome；用独立配置目录启动，不读取你日常浏览器的登录态。软件包包含原生组件的源码及预编译文件，没有安装时执行的脚本。

非默认 profile 需要在插件行配置 `profileDir`，指向实际 profile 绝对路径。插件数据默认放在 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`，也可由用户配置 `dataDir`。不要将个人路径写进公共发布文件。

更新后，先结束当前任务，再从系统托盘完整退出 DSH、重新打开并新建会话。`action=status` 应显示 `version: 0.5.4`、`backends.browser: dragon-cdp` 和 `supportedPlatform: Windows x64 only`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：默认 `owner`（手动确认）。没有预置应用或网站允许项。read 授权保持当前会话，control 授权保持当前任务轮次；网页写操作、原始坐标/键盘输入、语义 Invoke 等敏感动作另外逐次确认。应用启动等动作也需要确认。

`auto` 是用户主动选择的全局模式：跳过插件自己的范围询问和敏感动作确认，**也适用于 DSH 的 never 策略**。显式 `false` 拒绝项、管理员窗口限制、下载边界、急停等仍然生效。它不会替模型证明一个操作正确或安全。输入框旁「龙爪 · 手动 / 自动」切换到自动时会先提示确认；切回手动会清除已有授权并使待处理确认失效。

用户也可自行执行 `npm.cmd run mode -- owner` 或 `npm.cmd run mode -- auto`。工具没有修改模式或允许项的动作；模型不应通过其他工具给自己授权。

在 `owner` 模式下，DSH 必须允许询问。宿主 `approval/policy: never` 遇到未授权范围或需要逐次确认的动作会拒绝，不会自动放行。静态允许项只放行指定范围，不跳过敏感动作确认。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：配置文件 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json` 示例：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "mode": "owner",
  "apps": {},

应用键须为 exe 绝对路径，网站键须为精确 HTTP(S) origin，不支持通配符。任意 `execute` 页面脚本默认关闭，需要在 `permissions.json` 里把 `allowPageScript` 设为 `true`；打开后也不能读取密码输入框。独立浏览器只通过 CDP 驱动，不上传文件。

这些是插件自身的操作检查，**不是操作系统沙箱或网络防火墙**。被允许的页面仍可能运行自己的脚本和请求；拥有任意 Shell 执行权限的本地代码也能绕过插件。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。插件加载时会拦截并行的旧 GUI 和 `browser_*` 工具入口，引导模型使用本插件。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：保持两个工具，细节通过 `help` 按需读取：

```json
{"action":"help","args":{"action":"click"}}
```

桌面流程：`windows` 找到窗口 → `a11y` 读取控件 → 使用返回的 `a11y_id`、`element_id` 执行 `set_element_value` 等动作 → 读取新状态。旧句柄一次性消费，跨会话、过期、身份变化或不支持的 Pattern 均明确拒绝，不自动改用猜测坐标。密码、验证码、登录和 UAC 由用户处理。

需要坐标时先 `observe`，输入引用最新 `observation_id`，按返回的坐标模式操作。窗口移动、大小或 DPI 变化后重新观察；截图路线需要当前模型支持图像。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：桌面像素步骤可用 `observation_id: "previous"` 引用本批次之前步骤返回的新观察号；首步省略则沿用工具层请求里的 `observation_id`，后续步省略等同于 `previous`。不能嵌套 batch，不能在 batch 中调用 help/status。失败或超时可能已经产生副作用，须先观察，不能盲目重试提交。

抢焦点有硬保护：桌面输入只有在目标窗口仍是前台时才执行；输入结束（以及 `type` 点下去到开始打字之间）如果前台换成了别的窗口，直接报 `DRAGON_FOREGROUND_CHANGED` 并清掉观察，后续步骤停下，绝不会把抢到焦点的窗口当成新目标继续操作。要换窗口就显式 `focus_window` 或重新 `observe`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 连接已有浏览器：支持 tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab。每个标签的元数据也要 read 授权；写操作在手动模式逐次确认。选择的标签关闭后不会自动换到别的页面；确认期间 URL 或文档变化会拒绝过期操作。连接按 Agent/会话隔离，Esc/卸载时断开连接，不关闭用户浏览器。调试端口对本机其他进程同样有较高权限，用完应由用户关闭调试浏览器。

dsh-dragon-control README · 下载、日志和急停：浏览器下载和截图只能写入 `status.downloadsDirectory`（可含子目录，不能越界），不覆盖已有文件，上限 256MB。没有文件上传、CDP 文件传输、点击触发下载或通用另存为对话框封装。

日志只保留动作、耗时、结果和错误码，保留 14 天、总量约 10 MiB；不记录参数值、完整 URL、脚本或截图。日志不可写时停止动作。`history` 查看当前 Agent/会话的记录，不执行回放。DSH 会话附件、聊天日志及浏览器登录配置有各自的存储生命周期。

物理 Esc 取消所有已布防的本插件 GUI 任务，清除旧观察，禁止本轮模型重试；更新的用户消息才可恢复。程序注入的 Escape 不算用户急停。已完成的点击或远程请求无法撤回。观察蓝框在动作结束、急停、任务结束和卸载时请求隐藏。

dsh-dragon-control README · 测试与限制：本次 67 项回归测试通过；10 组真实 Windows 集成检查、真实 Chrome CDP 本地表单测试，以及新的自立浏览器真实无头 Edge 冒烟（open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute，22 项断言）通过。报告见 [release-verification.json](release-verification.json) 和 [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json)。使用自建窗口、本地网页、受控测试确认服务，未调用远程模型。

重新编译原生组件前请先退出 DSH：常驻模式下 `A11yProbe.exe` / `DragonNative.exe` 正在运行，Windows 会锁住 exe 导致编译写入失败。

```powershell
npm.cmd run build:native
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
npm.cmd run smoke:cdp
npm.cmd run smoke:self

dsh-dragon-control README · DSH 完整集成还需要指定官方运行环境：：$env:DSH_RUNTIME_ROOT = 'C:/path/to/official-dsh-runtime'
npm.cmd run test:integration
npm.cmd run pack:local
```

仍需人工验收：物理 Esc、DSH 确认界面、记事本完整保存流程、混合 DPI/多显示器、管理员窗口矩阵、真实模型任务规划，以及全新 DSH profile 的安装/卸载/回滚。文件上传、截图裁剪/标注和自动更新尚未实现。当前为预览版，不声明“市场最先进”或已完成独立安全审计。

dsh-dragon-control README · 开源、市场和卸载：GitHub 发布与市场收录是不同步骤。DSH 的发现页读取用户配置的市场索引；社区目录也有各自的收录审核。发布流程见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)，不会把“已提交审核”表述成“已上架”。

发布后，支持格式 1 索引的 DSH 发现页可添加此源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/main/market-index.json`。这是本项目自有索引，固定到已审查的源码提交；不会自动修改你已有的市场配置。

在 DSH 插件管理禁用/移除本插件并重启，可解除工具守卫并释放监听；插件自己启动的浏览器会随插件卸载关闭，复用的用户浏览器不会。权限文件、日志和独立浏览器配置保留，不静默删除用户数据。

MIT 许可；开发和测试由 Codex 与 DSH 辅助完成。贡献说明见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，第三方来源见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

dsh-dragon-control README · dsh-dragon-control：[中文](README.md) · 0.5.4 preview · MIT

**Windows x64 only. macOS, Linux, WSL and headless servers are unsupported, including for browser-only usage.**

Two tools for DSH Desktop conversations: `dragon_browser` and `dragon_desktop`. Use DOM browsing, native Windows UI Automation handles, or fresh screenshots for pixel input. Independent community project; not affiliated with DeepSeek or OpenAI.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Adapted combination: Windows x64, Node.js 24, DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, and a system installation of Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. The plugin now ships its own browser launcher and CDP client, so it runs standalone and does not need dsh-orb or dsh-builtin-browser.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：DSH plugin management can also install a local archive. On the first browser action the plugin looks for `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`, then the system Edge and Chrome, and launches it with its own profile directory, so your everyday browser logins are not reused. Data defaults to `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`; users can configure `dataDir`. The package includes native source and a prebuilt helper, with no install-time scripts.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Install from npm first: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control. You can also download the archive/checksums from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases), or install the version tag with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`. For immutable installation, use the full reviewed commit SHA instead of a tag.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Finish active work, fully quit DSH through its tray menu, restart and create a fresh conversation. `action=status` should return version 0.5.4, `backends.browser: dragon-cdp` and `Windows x64 only`.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：- DOM browsing, tab management, conditional waits, screenshots and confined URL downloads.
- Windows UIA Invoke, SetValue, Select, Toggle, Expand/Collapse and condition waits. Semantic actions do not need an image-capable model.
- Optional attachment to a user-enabled loopback Chrome/Edge debugging endpoint, preserving that browser profile's login state without exporting cookies.
- `batch` submits up to 50 actions. All parameter schemas are checked before any step executes. Execution stops on the first failure and each step is audited. Completed steps are not rolled back.
- App/origin scopes, default one-use confirmations, physical Escape stop and redacted local history.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：Use `{ "action": "help", "args": { "action": "click" } }` to load an action schema. For desktop actions: `windows` → `a11y` → an element action with the returned `a11y_id` and `element_id`. Handles are consumed once; changed, expired, password or unsupported controls fail explicitly. Pixel actions require a fresh `observation_id` and an image-capable model. Batch pixel steps may use `observation_id: "previous"` from a prior step in that batch. Batch cannot contain batch/help/status.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：0.5.0 makes the browser side self-contained: the plugin launches system Edge/Chrome with its own `user-data-dir` and drives it through its bundled CDP client. 0.4.1's fixes for CDP target selection, session isolation, tab metadata scopes, write confirmations, cancellation/timeouts, stale documents, mode changes and per-step validation remain in place.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：Default `owner` mode asks the Host for exact executable-path / top-level HTTP(S)-origin scopes. Read grants last for the Session, control grants for the turn. Browser mutations, pixel input, UIA Invoke and other conservative sensitive actions additionally require one-use confirmation. Host policy `never` rejects operations requiring a prompt, even with static scope grants.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：User-selected global `auto` mode skips this plugin's scope prompts and sensitive confirmations, **including with Host policy never**. Explicit target denials, platform limits, the stop latch and other hard restrictions still apply. The composer switch asks before enabling auto. Returning to owner revokes leases and invalidates pending approval. Users may also run `npm.cmd run mode -- owner|auto`; no model-facing action changes grants or modes.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：The file is `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json`. App keys are absolute executable paths, origin keys exact origins, no wildcards. Arbitrary separate-browser `execute` scripts are disabled unless the user enables `allowPageScript`. Built-in CDP DOM actions do not expose arbitrary script execution.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：These checks are not an OS sandbox or network firewall. Approved websites can run scripts and make their own requests. Arbitrary local shell code can bypass plugin boundaries. The plugin blocks older parallel Orb GUI / `browser_*` tool entries while loaded. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：The user must start the browser with a debugging port and a dedicated profile. The plugin only connects to the specified `127.0.0.1` port, rejects redirects/remote debugger addresses, and never restarts an everyday browser or copies its profile. Chrome 136+ requires a non-default user-data directory for remote debugging; log in separately in that profile. Never share one profile between concurrent browser processes. See [Chrome's official guidance](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：Supported operations: tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab. Tab metadata needs every origin's read scope. Mutations need owner-mode confirmation. A closed target is never silently replaced. Page/loader changes during approval stop stale input. Connections belong to an Agent/Session; Escape and unload disconnect them without closing the user's browser. A debugger also grants other local processes substantial browser access; close it after use.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Browser downloads and screenshots must stay inside `status.downloadsDirectory` (subdirectories allowed, escaping refused), use a new filename and are capped at 256 MB. File uploads, CDP transfers, click-triggered downloads and general Save As dialogs are not implemented.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Logs retain action/duration/outcome/error metadata for 14 days and approximately 10 MiB. They omit arguments, typed values, URLs, scripts and screenshots. Unwritable logs stop operations. `history` is Agent/Session-scoped and does not replay actions. Host chat, attachments and browser login profiles have separate retention rules.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Physical Escape cancels armed plugin GUI work, clears observations and blocks model retries until a later user message. Injected Escape is ignored. Cancellation cannot undo completed side effects; observe before retrying. Observation frames are hidden after actions, stop, turn end and unload.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：67 regression tests, 10 real Windows integration groups, an isolated real Chrome CDP local-form smoke test and a new self-hosted headless Edge smoke test (open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute, 22 assertions) passed. Reports: [release-verification.json](release-verification.json), [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json). Tests use owned fixtures and controlled approval services, with zero remote model calls.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：```powershell
npm.cmd run build:native
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
npm.cmd run smoke:cdp

Pending manual acceptance: physical Escape, DSH approval UI, Notepad save workflow, mixed-DPI/multiple displays, elevated windows, real-model planning and clean-profile install/uninstall/rollback. Screenshot cropping/annotation and automatic updates are also unimplemented. No independent security audit or claim of marketplace leadership.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for GitHub and separate marketplace/index submission. Disabling/removing the plugin and restarting releases its hooks; permissions, logs and backend login storage remain. MIT; development assisted by Codex and DSH. dsh-dragon-control README · 龙爪控制 · dsh-dragon-control：[English](README.en.md) · 0.5.4 preview · MIT

**仅支持 Windows x64。不适用于 macOS、Linux、WSL 或无桌面的服务器。即使只用网页功能，目前也需要 Windows 后端。**

为 DSH Desktop 普通会话提供 `dragon_browser` 和 `dragon_desktop` 两个工具：通过 DOM 操作网页，通过 Windows UI Automation 操作控件，必要时使用截图和坐标。独立社区项目，与 DeepSeek、OpenAI 无隶属关系。

dsh-dragon-control README · 能做什么：- 网页：打开、读取、DOM 点击、填表、多标签、条件等待、截图及 URL 下载。
- 桌面：列出和选择窗口；按 UIA 控件句柄执行 Invoke、SetValue、Select、Toggle、Expand/Collapse；等待控件出现或消失。语义路线无需视觉模型。
- 按需截图：点击、输入、按键、拖拽、打开应用默认只续上 `observation_id`，不抓图；要画面时再用 `observe`（始终截图）。省掉每一步 2560×1440 的 PNG，实测单步（`key`）从 1.0 秒降到 0.44 秒；会话内还要再省下每帧图片的传输与落盘。
- 原生层常驻：`DragonNative.exe` / `A11yProbe.exe` 同进程复用，插件层单步（`key`，含守卫）从 1.89 秒降到 0.30 秒，真实会话单步 `key` 从约 2.94 秒降到 **约 0.68 秒**（同机 5 次，648–720 ms）；窗口身份、坐标、观察号与 Esc 急停的校验一条没减。
- 接入用户主动开启调试端口的 Chrome/Edge；连接复用该浏览器配置中的登录态，不导出或复制 Cookie。
- `batch` 一次提交最多 50 步，先校验所有步骤，依次执行、遇错即停，并逐步记录脱敏日志。已执行的步骤不会回滚。
- 精确应用路径、网站顶层来源的 read/control 授权；默认敏感动作逐次确认；用户物理 Esc 急停。

dsh-dragon-control README · 能做什么：0.5.0 把网页侧也改为自立：插件自己启动本机 Edge/Chrome（独立 `user-data-dir`）并用自带的 CDP 客户端驱动，不再需要 `dsh-builtin-browser` 或 `dsh-orb` 的 Electron。0.4.1 修复的 CDP 标签选择、跨会话隔离、标签元数据权限、写操作确认、超时取消及页面变化后的过期操作仍然有效。详见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：目前适配的组合：**Windows x64、Node.js 24、DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2、本机已安装的 Microsoft Edge 或 Google Chrome**。插件自带浏览器启动层和 CDP 客户端，不依赖其他插件；装好本插件即可单独运行。其他版本不承诺兼容。

直接在目标 DSH profile 安装本插件即可。使用默认的 `desktop` profile 时，可在兼容的 DSH CLI 中执行：

首选 npm 安装：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control。也可以从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases) 下载 tgz 和校验文件，或按版本标签安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`。需要不可变安装时，将标签换成完整源码提交 SHA。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

也可通过 DSH 插件管理安装本地 tgz。首次执行网页动作时，插件会查找 `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`，否则依次尝试系统 Edge、Chrome；用独立配置目录启动，不读取你日常浏览器的登录态。软件包包含原生组件的源码及预编译文件，没有安装时执行的脚本。

非默认 profile 需要在插件行配置 `profileDir`，指向实际 profile 绝对路径。插件数据默认放在 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`，也可由用户配置 `dataDir`。不要将个人路径写进公共发布文件。

更新后，先结束当前任务，再从系统托盘完整退出 DSH、重新打开并新建会话。`action=status` 应显示 `version: 0.5.4`、`backends.browser: dragon-cdp` 和 `supportedPlatform: Windows x64 only`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：默认 `owner`（手动确认）。没有预置应用或网站允许项。read 授权保持当前会话，control 授权保持当前任务轮次；网页写操作、原始坐标/键盘输入、语义 Invoke 等敏感动作另外逐次确认。应用启动等动作也需要确认。

`auto` 是用户主动选择的全局模式：跳过插件自己的范围询问和敏感动作确认，**也适用于 DSH 的 never 策略**。显式 `false` 拒绝项、管理员窗口限制、下载边界、急停等仍然生效。它不会替模型证明一个操作正确或安全。输入框旁「龙爪 · 手动 / 自动」切换到自动时会先提示确认；切回手动会清除已有授权并使待处理确认失效。

用户也可自行执行 `npm.cmd run mode -- owner` 或 `npm.cmd run mode -- auto`。工具没有修改模式或允许项的动作；模型不应通过其他工具给自己授权。

在 `owner` 模式下，DSH 必须允许询问。宿主 `approval/policy: never` 遇到未授权范围或需要逐次确认的动作会拒绝，不会自动放行。静态允许项只放行指定范围，不跳过敏感动作确认。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：配置文件 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json` 示例：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "mode": "owner",
  "apps": {},

应用键须为 exe 绝对路径，网站键须为精确 HTTP(S) origin，不支持通配符。任意 `execute` 页面脚本默认关闭，需要在 `permissions.json` 里把 `allowPageScript` 设为 `true`；打开后也不能读取密码输入框。独立浏览器只通过 CDP 驱动，不上传文件。

这些是插件自身的操作检查，**不是操作系统沙箱或网络防火墙**。被允许的页面仍可能运行自己的脚本和请求；拥有任意 Shell 执行权限的本地代码也能绕过插件。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。插件加载时会拦截并行的旧 GUI 和 `browser_*` 工具入口，引导模型使用本插件。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：保持两个工具，细节通过 `help` 按需读取：

```json
{"action":"help","args":{"action":"click"}}
```

桌面流程：`windows` 找到窗口 → `a11y` 读取控件 → 使用返回的 `a11y_id`、`element_id` 执行 `set_element_value` 等动作 → 读取新状态。旧句柄一次性消费，跨会话、过期、身份变化或不支持的 Pattern 均明确拒绝，不自动改用猜测坐标。密码、验证码、登录和 UAC 由用户处理。

需要坐标时先 `observe`，输入引用最新 `observation_id`，按返回的坐标模式操作。窗口移动、大小或 DPI 变化后重新观察；截图路线需要当前模型支持图像。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：桌面像素步骤可用 `observation_id: "previous"` 引用本批次之前步骤返回的新观察号；首步省略则沿用工具层请求里的 `observation_id`，后续步省略等同于 `previous`。不能嵌套 batch，不能在 batch 中调用 help/status。失败或超时可能已经产生副作用，须先观察，不能盲目重试提交。

抢焦点有硬保护：桌面输入只有在目标窗口仍是前台时才执行；输入结束（以及 `type` 点下去到开始打字之间）如果前台换成了别的窗口，直接报 `DRAGON_FOREGROUND_CHANGED` 并清掉观察，后续步骤停下，绝不会把抢到焦点的窗口当成新目标继续操作。要换窗口就显式 `focus_window` 或重新 `observe`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 连接已有浏览器：支持 tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab。每个标签的元数据也要 read 授权；写操作在手动模式逐次确认。选择的标签关闭后不会自动换到别的页面；确认期间 URL 或文档变化会拒绝过期操作。连接按 Agent/会话隔离，Esc/卸载时断开连接，不关闭用户浏览器。调试端口对本机其他进程同样有较高权限，用完应由用户关闭调试浏览器。

dsh-dragon-control README · 下载、日志和急停：浏览器下载和截图只能写入 `status.downloadsDirectory`（可含子目录，不能越界），不覆盖已有文件，上限 256MB。没有文件上传、CDP 文件传输、点击触发下载或通用另存为对话框封装。

日志只保留动作、耗时、结果和错误码，保留 14 天、总量约 10 MiB；不记录参数值、完整 URL、脚本或截图。日志不可写时停止动作。`history` 查看当前 Agent/会话的记录，不执行回放。DSH 会话附件、聊天日志及浏览器登录配置有各自的存储生命周期。

物理 Esc 取消所有已布防的本插件 GUI 任务，清除旧观察，禁止本轮模型重试；更新的用户消息才可恢复。程序注入的 Escape 不算用户急停。已完成的点击或远程请求无法撤回。观察蓝框在动作结束、急停、任务结束和卸载时请求隐藏。

dsh-dragon-control README · 测试与限制：本次 67 项回归测试通过；10 组真实 Windows 集成检查、真实 Chrome CDP 本地表单测试，以及新的自立浏览器真实无头 Edge 冒烟（open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute，22 项断言）通过。报告见 [release-verification.json](release-verification.json) 和 [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json)。使用自建窗口、本地网页、受控测试确认服务，未调用远程模型。

重新编译原生组件前请先退出 DSH：常驻模式下 `A11yProbe.exe` / `DragonNative.exe` 正在运行，Windows 会锁住 exe 导致编译写入失败。

```powershell
npm.cmd run build:native
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
npm.cmd run smoke:cdp
npm.cmd run smoke:self

dsh-dragon-control README · DSH 完整集成还需要指定官方运行环境：：$env:DSH_RUNTIME_ROOT = 'C:/path/to/official-dsh-runtime'
npm.cmd run test:integration
npm.cmd run pack:local
```

仍需人工验收：物理 Esc、DSH 确认界面、记事本完整保存流程、混合 DPI/多显示器、管理员窗口矩阵、真实模型任务规划，以及全新 DSH profile 的安装/卸载/回滚。文件上传、截图裁剪/标注和自动更新尚未实现。当前为预览版，不声明“市场最先进”或已完成独立安全审计。

dsh-dragon-control README · dsh-dragon-control：[中文](README.md) · 0.5.4 preview · MIT

**Windows x64 only. macOS, Linux, WSL and headless servers are unsupported, including for browser-only usage.**

Two tools for DSH Desktop conversations: `dragon_browser` and `dragon_desktop`. Use DOM browsing, native Windows UI Automation handles, or fresh screenshots for pixel input. Independent community project; not affiliated with DeepSeek or OpenAI.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Adapted combination: Windows x64, Node.js 24, DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, and a system installation of Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. The plugin now ships its own browser launcher and CDP client, so it runs standalone and does not need dsh-orb or dsh-builtin-browser.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：DSH plugin management can also install a local archive. On the first browser action the plugin looks for `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`, then the system Edge and Chrome, and launches it with its own profile directory, so your everyday browser logins are not reused. Data defaults to `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`; users can configure `dataDir`. The package includes native source and a prebuilt helper, with no install-time scripts.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Install from npm first: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control. You can also download the archive/checksums from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases), or install the version tag with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`. For immutable installation, use the full reviewed commit SHA instead of a tag.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Finish active work, fully quit DSH through its tray menu, restart and create a fresh conversation. `action=status` should return version 0.5.4, `backends.browser: dragon-cdp` and `Windows x64 only`.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：- DOM browsing, tab management, conditional waits, screenshots and confined URL downloads.
- Windows UIA Invoke, SetValue, Select, Toggle, Expand/Collapse and condition waits. Semantic actions do not need an image-capable model.
- Optional attachment to a user-enabled loopback Chrome/Edge debugging endpoint, preserving that browser profile's login state without exporting cookies.
- `batch` submits up to 50 actions. All parameter schemas are checked before any step executes. Execution stops on the first failure and each step is audited. Completed steps are not rolled back.
- App/origin scopes, default one-use confirmations, physical Escape stop and redacted local history.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：Use `{ "action": "help", "args": { "action": "click" } }` to load an action schema. For desktop actions: `windows` → `a11y` → an element action with the returned `a11y_id` and `element_id`. Handles are consumed once; changed, expired, password or unsupported controls fail explicitly. Pixel actions require a fresh `observation_id` and an image-capable model. Batch pixel steps may use `observation_id: "previous"` from a prior step in that batch. Batch cannot contain batch/help/status.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：0.5.0 makes the browser side self-contained: the plugin launches system Edge/Chrome with its own `user-data-dir` and drives it through its bundled CDP client. 0.4.1's fixes for CDP target selection, session isolation, tab metadata scopes, write confirmations, cancellation/timeouts, stale documents, mode changes and per-step validation remain in place.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：Default `owner` mode asks the Host for exact executable-path / top-level HTTP(S)-origin scopes. Read grants last for the Session, control grants for the turn. Browser mutations, pixel input, UIA Invoke and other conservative sensitive actions additionally require one-use confirmation. Host policy `never` rejects operations requiring a prompt, even with static scope grants.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：User-selected global `auto` mode skips this plugin's scope prompts and sensitive confirmations, **including with Host policy never**. Explicit target denials, platform limits, the stop latch and other hard restrictions still apply. The composer switch asks before enabling auto. Returning to owner revokes leases and invalidates pending approval. Users may also run `npm.cmd run mode -- owner|auto`; no model-facing action changes grants or modes.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：The file is `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json`. App keys are absolute executable paths, origin keys exact origins, no wildcards. Arbitrary separate-browser `execute` scripts are disabled unless the user enables `allowPageScript`. Built-in CDP DOM actions do not expose arbitrary script execution.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：These checks are not an OS sandbox or network firewall. Approved websites can run scripts and make their own requests. Arbitrary local shell code can bypass plugin boundaries. The plugin blocks older parallel Orb GUI / `browser_*` tool entries while loaded. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：The user must start the browser with a debugging port and a dedicated profile. The plugin only connects to the specified `127.0.0.1` port, rejects redirects/remote debugger addresses, and never restarts an everyday browser or copies its profile. Chrome 136+ requires a non-default user-data directory for remote debugging; log in separately in that profile. Never share one profile between concurrent browser processes. See [Chrome's official guidance](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：Supported operations: tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab. Tab metadata needs every origin's read scope. Mutations need owner-mode confirmation. A closed target is never silently replaced. Page/loader changes during approval stop stale input. Connections belong to an Agent/Session; Escape and unload disconnect them without closing the user's browser. A debugger also grants other local processes substantial browser access; close it after use.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Browser downloads and screenshots must stay inside `status.downloadsDirectory` (subdirectories allowed, escaping refused), use a new filename and are capped at 256 MB. File uploads, CDP transfers, click-triggered downloads and general Save As dialogs are not implemented.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Logs retain action/duration/outcome/error metadata for 14 days and approximately 10 MiB. They omit arguments, typed values, URLs, scripts and screenshots. Unwritable logs stop operations. `history` is Agent/Session-scoped and does not replay actions. Host chat, attachments and browser login profiles have separate retention rules.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Physical Escape cancels armed plugin GUI work, clears observations and blocks model retries until a later user message. Injected Escape is ignored. Cancellation cannot undo completed side effects; observe before retrying. Observation frames are hidden after actions, stop, turn end and unload.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：67 regression tests, 10 real Windows integration groups, an isolated real Chrome CDP local-form smoke test and a new self-hosted headless Edge smoke test (open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute, 22 assertions) passed. Reports: [release-verification.json](release-verification.json), [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json). Tests use owned fixtures and controlled approval services, with zero remote model calls.

npm.cmd test

Pending manual acceptance: physical Escape, DSH approval UI, Notepad save workflow, mixed-DPI/multiple displays, elevated windows, real-model planning and clean-profile install/uninstall/rollback. Screenshot cropping/annotation and automatic updates are also unimplemented. No independent security audit or claim of marketplace leadership.

- 桌面：列出和选择窗口；按 UIA 控件句柄执行 Invoke、SetValue、Select、Toggle、Expand/Collapse；等待控件出现或消失。语义路线无需视觉模型。
- 按需截图：点击、输入、按键、拖拽、打开应用默认只续上 `observation_id`，不抓图；要画面时再用 `observe`（始终截图）。省掉每一步 2560×1440 的 PNG，实测单步（`key`）从 1.0 秒降到 0.44 秒；会话内还要再省下每帧图片的传输与落盘。
- 原生层常驻：`DragonNative.exe` / `A11yProbe.exe` 同进程复用，插件层单步（`key`，含守卫）从 1.89 秒降到 0.30 秒，真实会话单步 `key` 从约 2.94 秒降到 **约 0.68 秒**（同机 5 次，648–720 ms）；窗口身份、坐标、观察号与 Esc 急停的校验一条没减。
- 接入用户主动开启调试端口的 Chrome/Edge；连接复用该浏览器配置中的登录态，不导出或复制 Cookie。
- `batch` 一次提交最多 50 步，先校验所有步骤，依次执行、遇错即停，并逐步记录脱敏日志。已执行的步骤不会回滚。
- 精确应用路径、网站顶层来源的 read/control 授权；默认敏感动作逐次确认；用户物理 Esc 急停。

dsh-dragon-control README · 能做什么：0.5.0 把网页侧也改为自立：插件自己启动本机 Edge/Chrome（独立 `user-data-dir`）并用自带的 CDP 客户端驱动，不再需要 `dsh-builtin-browser` 或 `dsh-orb` 的 Electron。0.4.1 修复的 CDP 标签选择、跨会话隔离、标签元数据权限、写操作确认、超时取消及页面变化后的过期操作仍然有效。详见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：目前适配的组合：**Windows x64、Node.js 24、DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2、本机已安装的 Microsoft Edge 或 Google Chrome**。插件自带浏览器启动层和 CDP 客户端，不依赖其他插件；装好本插件即可单独运行。其他版本不承诺兼容。

直接在目标 DSH profile 安装本插件即可。使用默认的 `desktop` profile 时，可在兼容的 DSH CLI 中执行：

首选 npm 安装：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control。也可以从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases) 下载 tgz 和校验文件，或按版本标签安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`。需要不可变安装时，将标签换成完整源码提交 SHA。

dsh-dragon-control README · 环境与安装：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

也可通过 DSH 插件管理安装本地 tgz。首次执行网页动作时，插件会查找 `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`，否则依次尝试系统 Edge、Chrome；用独立配置目录启动，不读取你日常浏览器的登录态。软件包包含原生组件的源码及预编译文件，没有安装时执行的脚本。

非默认 profile 需要在插件行配置 `profileDir`，指向实际 profile 绝对路径。插件数据默认放在 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`，也可由用户配置 `dataDir`。不要将个人路径写进公共发布文件。

更新后，先结束当前任务，再从系统托盘完整退出 DSH、重新打开并新建会话。`action=status` 应显示 `version: 0.5.4`、`backends.browser: dragon-cdp` 和 `supportedPlatform: Windows x64 only`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：默认 `owner`（手动确认）。没有预置应用或网站允许项。read 授权保持当前会话，control 授权保持当前任务轮次；网页写操作、原始坐标/键盘输入、语义 Invoke 等敏感动作另外逐次确认。应用启动等动作也需要确认。

`auto` 是用户主动选择的全局模式：跳过插件自己的范围询问和敏感动作确认，**也适用于 DSH 的 never 策略**。显式 `false` 拒绝项、管理员窗口限制、下载边界、急停等仍然生效。它不会替模型证明一个操作正确或安全。输入框旁「龙爪 · 手动 / 自动」切换到自动时会先提示确认；切回手动会清除已有授权并使待处理确认失效。

用户也可自行执行 `npm.cmd run mode -- owner` 或 `npm.cmd run mode -- auto`。工具没有修改模式或允许项的动作；模型不应通过其他工具给自己授权。

在 `owner` 模式下，DSH 必须允许询问。宿主 `approval/policy: never` 遇到未授权范围或需要逐次确认的动作会拒绝，不会自动放行。静态允许项只放行指定范围，不跳过敏感动作确认。

dsh-dragon-control README · 权限模式：配置文件 `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json` 示例：

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "mode": "owner",
  "apps": {},

应用键须为 exe 绝对路径，网站键须为精确 HTTP(S) origin，不支持通配符。任意 `execute` 页面脚本默认关闭，需要在 `permissions.json` 里把 `allowPageScript` 设为 `true`；打开后也不能读取密码输入框。独立浏览器只通过 CDP 驱动，不上传文件。

这些是插件自身的操作检查，**不是操作系统沙箱或网络防火墙**。被允许的页面仍可能运行自己的脚本和请求；拥有任意 Shell 执行权限的本地代码也能绕过插件。详见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。插件加载时会拦截并行的旧 GUI 和 `browser_*` 工具入口，引导模型使用本插件。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：保持两个工具，细节通过 `help` 按需读取：

```json
{"action":"help","args":{"action":"click"}}
```

桌面流程：`windows` 找到窗口 → `a11y` 读取控件 → 使用返回的 `a11y_id`、`element_id` 执行 `set_element_value` 等动作 → 读取新状态。旧句柄一次性消费，跨会话、过期、身份变化或不支持的 Pattern 均明确拒绝，不自动改用猜测坐标。密码、验证码、登录和 UAC 由用户处理。

需要坐标时先 `observe`，输入引用最新 `observation_id`，按返回的坐标模式操作。窗口移动、大小或 DPI 变化后重新观察；截图路线需要当前模型支持图像。

dsh-dragon-control README · 使用：桌面像素步骤可用 `observation_id: "previous"` 引用本批次之前步骤返回的新观察号；首步省略则沿用工具层请求里的 `observation_id`，后续步省略等同于 `previous`。不能嵌套 batch，不能在 batch 中调用 help/status。失败或超时可能已经产生副作用，须先观察，不能盲目重试提交。

抢焦点有硬保护：桌面输入只有在目标窗口仍是前台时才执行；输入结束（以及 `type` 点下去到开始打字之间）如果前台换成了别的窗口，直接报 `DRAGON_FOREGROUND_CHANGED` 并清掉观察，后续步骤停下，绝不会把抢到焦点的窗口当成新目标继续操作。要换窗口就显式 `focus_window` 或重新 `observe`。

dsh-dragon-control README · 连接已有浏览器：支持 tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab。每个标签的元数据也要 read 授权；写操作在手动模式逐次确认。选择的标签关闭后不会自动换到别的页面；确认期间 URL 或文档变化会拒绝过期操作。连接按 Agent/会话隔离，Esc/卸载时断开连接，不关闭用户浏览器。调试端口对本机其他进程同样有较高权限，用完应由用户关闭调试浏览器。

dsh-dragon-control README · 下载、日志和急停：浏览器下载和截图只能写入 `status.downloadsDirectory`（可含子目录，不能越界），不覆盖已有文件，上限 256MB。没有文件上传、CDP 文件传输、点击触发下载或通用另存为对话框封装。

日志只保留动作、耗时、结果和错误码，保留 14 天、总量约 10 MiB；不记录参数值、完整 URL、脚本或截图。日志不可写时停止动作。`history` 查看当前 Agent/会话的记录，不执行回放。DSH 会话附件、聊天日志及浏览器登录配置有各自的存储生命周期。

物理 Esc 取消所有已布防的本插件 GUI 任务，清除旧观察，禁止本轮模型重试；更新的用户消息才可恢复。程序注入的 Escape 不算用户急停。已完成的点击或远程请求无法撤回。观察蓝框在动作结束、急停、任务结束和卸载时请求隐藏。

dsh-dragon-control README · 测试与限制：本次 67 项回归测试通过；10 组真实 Windows 集成检查、真实 Chrome CDP 本地表单测试，以及新的自立浏览器真实无头 Edge 冒烟（open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute，22 项断言）通过。报告见 [release-verification.json](release-verification.json) 和 [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json)。使用自建窗口、本地网页、受控测试确认服务，未调用远程模型。

重新编译原生组件前请先退出 DSH：常驻模式下 `A11yProbe.exe` / `DragonNative.exe` 正在运行，Windows 会锁住 exe 导致编译写入失败。

```powershell
npm.cmd run build:native
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
npm.cmd run smoke:cdp
npm.cmd run smoke:self

dsh-dragon-control README · DSH 完整集成还需要指定官方运行环境：：$env:DSH_RUNTIME_ROOT = 'C:/path/to/official-dsh-runtime'
npm.cmd run test:integration
npm.cmd run pack:local
```

仍需人工验收：物理 Esc、DSH 确认界面、记事本完整保存流程、混合 DPI/多显示器、管理员窗口矩阵、真实模型任务规划，以及全新 DSH profile 的安装/卸载/回滚。文件上传、截图裁剪/标注和自动更新尚未实现。当前为预览版，不声明“市场最先进”或已完成独立安全审计。

dsh-dragon-control README · 开源、市场和卸载：GitHub 发布与市场收录是不同步骤。DSH 的发现页读取用户配置的市场索引；社区目录也有各自的收录审核。发布流程见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)，不会把“已提交审核”表述成“已上架”。

发布后，支持格式 1 索引的 DSH 发现页可添加此源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/main/market-index.json`。这是本项目自有索引，固定到已审查的源码提交；不会自动修改你已有的市场配置。

在 DSH 插件管理禁用/移除本插件并重启，可解除工具守卫并释放监听；插件自己启动的浏览器会随插件卸载关闭，复用的用户浏览器不会。权限文件、日志和独立浏览器配置保留，不静默删除用户数据。

MIT 许可；开发和测试由 Codex 与 DSH 辅助完成。贡献说明见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，第三方来源见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

dsh-dragon-control README · dsh-dragon-control：[中文](README.md) · 0.5.4 preview · MIT

**Windows x64 only. macOS, Linux, WSL and headless servers are unsupported, including for browser-only usage.**

Two tools for DSH Desktop conversations: `dragon_browser` and `dragon_desktop`. Use DOM browsing, native Windows UI Automation handles, or fresh screenshots for pixel input. Independent community project; not affiliated with DeepSeek or OpenAI.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Adapted combination: Windows x64, Node.js 24, DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, and a system installation of Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome. The plugin now ships its own browser launcher and CDP client, so it runs standalone and does not need dsh-orb or dsh-builtin-browser.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add C:/path/to/dsh-dragon-control-0.5.4.tgz
```

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：DSH plugin management can also install a local archive. On the first browser action the plugin looks for `DRAGON_BROWSER_PATH`, then the system Edge and Chrome, and launches it with its own profile directory, so your everyday browser logins are not reused. Data defaults to `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control`; users can configure `dataDir`. The package includes native source and a prebuilt helper, with no install-time scripts.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Install from npm first: dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-dragon-control. You can also download the archive/checksums from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/releases), or install the version tag with `dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control#v0.5.4`. For immutable installation, use the full reviewed commit SHA instead of a tag.

dsh-dragon-control README · Requirements and installation：Finish active work, fully quit DSH through its tray menu, restart and create a fresh conversation. `action=status` should return version 0.5.4, `backends.browser: dragon-cdp` and `Windows x64 only`.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：- DOM browsing, tab management, conditional waits, screenshots and confined URL downloads.
- Windows UIA Invoke, SetValue, Select, Toggle, Expand/Collapse and condition waits. Semantic actions do not need an image-capable model.
- Optional attachment to a user-enabled loopback Chrome/Edge debugging endpoint, preserving that browser profile's login state without exporting cookies.
- `batch` submits up to 50 actions. All parameter schemas are checked before any step executes. Execution stops on the first failure and each step is audited. Completed steps are not rolled back.
- App/origin scopes, default one-use confirmations, physical Escape stop and redacted local history.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：Use `{ "action": "help", "args": { "action": "click" } }` to load an action schema. For desktop actions: `windows` → `a11y` → an element action with the returned `a11y_id` and `element_id`. Handles are consumed once; changed, expired, password or unsupported controls fail explicitly. Pixel actions require a fresh `observation_id` and an image-capable model. Batch pixel steps may use `observation_id: "previous"` from a prior step in that batch. Batch cannot contain batch/help/status.

dsh-dragon-control README · Features and usage：0.5.0 makes the browser side self-contained: the plugin launches system Edge/Chrome with its own `user-data-dir` and drives it through its bundled CDP client. 0.4.1's fixes for CDP target selection, session isolation, tab metadata scopes, write confirmations, cancellation/timeouts, stale documents, mode changes and per-step validation remain in place.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：Default `owner` mode asks the Host for exact executable-path / top-level HTTP(S)-origin scopes. Read grants last for the Session, control grants for the turn. Browser mutations, pixel input, UIA Invoke and other conservative sensitive actions additionally require one-use confirmation. Host policy `never` rejects operations requiring a prompt, even with static scope grants.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：User-selected global `auto` mode skips this plugin's scope prompts and sensitive confirmations, **including with Host policy never**. Explicit target denials, platform limits, the stop latch and other hard restrictions still apply. The composer switch asks before enabling auto. Returning to owner revokes leases and invalidates pending approval. Users may also run `npm.cmd run mode -- owner|auto`; no model-facing action changes grants or modes.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：The file is `<DSH_HOME>/dragon-control/permissions.json`. App keys are absolute executable paths, origin keys exact origins, no wildcards. Arbitrary separate-browser `execute` scripts are disabled unless the user enables `allowPageScript`. Built-in CDP DOM actions do not expose arbitrary script execution.

dsh-dragon-control README · Permissions：These checks are not an OS sandbox or network firewall. Approved websites can run scripts and make their own requests. Arbitrary local shell code can bypass plugin boundaries. The plugin blocks older parallel Orb GUI / `browser_*` tool entries while loaded. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：The user must start the browser with a debugging port and a dedicated profile. The plugin only connects to the specified `127.0.0.1` port, rejects redirects/remote debugger addresses, and never restarts an everyday browser or copies its profile. Chrome 136+ requires a non-default user-data directory for remote debugging; log in separately in that profile. Never share one profile between concurrent browser processes. See [Chrome's official guidance](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/remote-debugging-port).

dsh-dragon-control README · Attaching a browser：Supported operations: tabs/current/content/text/screenshot/wait/click/fill/type/key/scroll/back/forward/reload/open/goto/switch/close/new_tab. Tab metadata needs every origin's read scope. Mutations need owner-mode confirmation. A closed target is never silently replaced. Page/loader changes during approval stop stale input. Connections belong to an Agent/Session; Escape and unload disconnect them without closing the user's browser. A debugger also grants other local processes substantial browser access; close it after use.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Browser downloads and screenshots must stay inside `status.downloadsDirectory` (subdirectories allowed, escaping refused), use a new filename and are capped at 256 MB. File uploads, CDP transfers, click-triggered downloads and general Save As dialogs are not implemented.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Logs retain action/duration/outcome/error metadata for 14 days and approximately 10 MiB. They omit arguments, typed values, URLs, scripts and screenshots. Unwritable logs stop operations. `history` is Agent/Session-scoped and does not replay actions. Host chat, attachments and browser login profiles have separate retention rules.

dsh-dragon-control README · Downloads, history and stop：Physical Escape cancels armed plugin GUI work, clears observations and blocks model retries until a later user message. Injected Escape is ignored. Cancellation cannot undo completed side effects; observe before retrying. Observation frames are hidden after actions, stop, turn end and unload.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：67 regression tests, 10 real Windows integration groups, an isolated real Chrome CDP local-form smoke test and a new self-hosted headless Edge smoke test (open/snapshot/fill/click/wait/a11y/scrape/screenshot/execute, 22 assertions) passed. Reports: [release-verification.json](release-verification.json), [cdp-verification.json](cdp-verification.json). Tests use owned fixtures and controlled approval services, with zero remote model calls.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：```powershell
npm.cmd run build:native
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
npm.cmd run smoke:cdp

Pending manual acceptance: physical Escape, DSH approval UI, Notepad save workflow, mixed-DPI/multiple displays, elevated windows, real-model planning and clean-profile install/uninstall/rollback. Screenshot cropping/annotation and automatic updates are also unimplemented. No independent security audit or claim of marketplace leadership.

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md) for GitHub and separate marketplace/index submission. Disabling/removing the plugin and restarting releases its hooks; permissions, logs and backend login storage remain. MIT; development assisted by Codex and DSH. [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-dragon-control README · Validation and preview limits：After publication, DSH builds supporting format-1 indexes can add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wangtheme-coder/dsh-dragon-control/main/market-index.json`. This independently maintained index pins the reviewed source commit; it does not replace users' existing market configuration.
